scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && echo 'Не забудьте установить зависимости Python!'
scripts.predev: npm run verify:sync && node scripts/ensure-dev-ports.js --kill && npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "DB,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run db:logs" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.devrestart: npm run dev:kill && npm run dev
scripts.test:pytest: npm run test:db:up && npm run test:db:wait && cd backend && cross-env TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://ktm2000_user:ktm2000_pass_test@localhost:5441/ktm2000_test pytest -n auto -q
scripts.test:pytest:full: npm run test:db:up && npm run test:db:wait && cd backend && cross-env TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://ktm2000_user:ktm2000_pass_test@localhost:5441/ktm2000_test pytest -q
scripts.test:pytest:mon: npm run test:db:up && npm run test:db:wait && cd backend && cross-env TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://ktm2000_user:ktm2000_pass_test@localhost:5441/ktm2000_test pytest --testmon -q
scripts.test:pytest:lf: npm run test:db:up && npm run test:db:wait && cd backend && cross-env TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://ktm2000_user:ktm2000_pass_test@localhost:5441/ktm2000_test pytest --lf -q
